learning_outcomes.text: to model industrial problems as Mathematical Optimization problems
to solve Mathematical Optimization problems using appropriate solution algorithms
to interpret the solutions provided by algorithms to support decision-making processes

syllabus_topics: General Information on Mathematical Optimization Problems
overview on Duality and Sensitivity Analysis

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (Knowledge of methodological and theoretical aspects)

assessment_rules: The written exam assesses modeling skills (approximately 10 points), knowledge of algorithmic procedures (approximately 10 points), and knowledge of methodological and theoretical aspects (approximately 10 points). Grades reflect levels of preparation from sufficient to in-depth. The exam type is oral.
bibliography: "Introduction to Linear Optimization", D. Bertsimas, J.N. Tsitsikis. Athena Scientific.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Industriale (Industrial Engineering), classe L-9 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria industriale
